data.title: The Beach Collection Villas
data.about:
The Beach Collection Villas by Nakheel at Palm Jebel Ali offers luxury living with private beach access. These exquisite 5 and 6-bedroom villas are available in eight distinct styles: Sapphire, Tropical Mist, Provence, Indigo Ocean, Mediterranean, Azure Blue, Aquamarine, and Blue Horizon.  Each Beach Collection villa spans three floors and features spacious living areas, a private pool, and a stunning terrace with Arabian Gulf views.

The Beach Collection Frond C by Nakheel provides premium amenities such as private beaches, beautifully landscaped gardens, and garages for two cars. Eight unique villa designs offer exceptional layouts. The light, natural-inspired interiors create a serene atmosphere, perfect for modern living. Located on Palm Jebel Ali, the Beach Collection provides a prime location with the longest coastline in Dubai, delivering a harmonious blend of luxury and nature.

characteristics_module.title: Discover The Beach Collection by Nakheel Properties
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Beachfront Living: The Beach Collection Villas by Nakheel at Frond C Palm Jebel Ali offer private beach access, making them one of the most luxurious options in Dubai.
  • Iconic Location: Situated on Palm Jebel Ali, these villas offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and easy connectivity to Dubai’s key attractions.
  • Spacious Villas: The Beach Collection at Palm Jebel Ali offers 5 to 6-bedroom villas, each with expansive living spaces, luxurious interiors, and premium finishes.
  • World Class Amenities: Residents enjoy a private pool, BBQ area, two-car garage, and lush gardens as part of The Beach Collection Amenities.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: The Beach Collection Payment Plan offers flexibility, allowing investors and homeowners to secure their villas with convenient terms.
  • Elegant Design: The Beach Collection villas feature eight unique styles, natural motifs, and high-quality materials like marble, wood, and gold finishes.
  • Future Investment Potential: The Beach Collection Location, part of the renowned Palm Jebel Ali project, promises future growth and appreciation as the area develops further.

location_tile.title: Palm Jebel Ali: A Grand Expansion of Luxury Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Beach Collection Villas by Nakheel at Palm Jebel Ali is ideally located on the island's lower fronds. Palm Jebel Ali, an ambitious project, is set to be twice the size of Palm Jumeirah and features an expansive 68-mile coastline. The island will house luxury villas, five-star hotels, and premium residences, offering world-class services and amenities.

  • 30 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 30 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 40 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 45 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
